title: Queen's Territory
location: Ruined Metropolis — Outskirts of a fallen alien city
summary: The scavengers in the dead city answer to something that holds ground like a soldier and thinks like a tactician. If Keisha didn't make it off the medical floor, this is who kept her promise the only way the program left her.

objectives.text: Move through the ruined outskirts. Her territory has a perimeter and the perimeter has rules.
She summons before she swings. Break her adds or break her line of sight.

args.text: She fights like she's still guarding a door. She is. It's just not yours anymore.

objectives.text: Confront the Breeder Queen. There's a security specialist's discipline in how she holds the room. Find out if there's anything else left.
She stops guarding the door at last. You hope, somewhere, someone learned to be loud.
The plaza goes quiet. The scavengers scatter without their captain. You don't look back at the model number on the wall.

_hooks: Beta-path sibling of act2_the_siren_call: the Breeder Queen (transformed Keisha, canon L16 territory — act2-roster ships BossBreederQueen.glb + the BreederQueen boss def with phase-3 summons). give:{girl_lost:keisha} gates the OFFER, so only a Beta run sees it. Keisha's character (a promise-keeper, 'guard the door') is honored even in her lost-state line; the release path reuses her infected_lost tree. Both Beta-boss missions feed STORYLINE_EXPANSIONS (f3) Hollow Crown / Chen's-Redemption overlays.
_voice: Keisha's whole self is in 'she fights like she's still guarding a door.' The horror is the persistence of who she was, bent to the program's use. No gore, no spectacle of her body — the menace is tactical and the grief is quiet.
